# H2ODB — Sum by Hour

```{tags} reference, query-template, h2odb
```

> [H2ODB](../../h2odb.md) benchmark · [all H2ODB queries](index.md)

SUM(fare_amount) GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM pickup_datetime)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  EXTRACT(HOUR FROM pickup_datetime) AS hour,
  SUM(fare_amount) AS sum_fare_amount
FROM trips
GROUP BY
  EXTRACT(HOUR FROM pickup_datetime)
ORDER BY
  hour
```

## Representative DataFrame

Expression family (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion), default parameters.

```python
def q7_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    """Q7: SUM(fare_amount) GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR)."""
    trips = ctx.get_table("trips")
    col = ctx.col
    return (
        trips.with_columns(col("pickup_datetime").dt.hour().alias("hour"))
        .group_by("hour")
        .agg(col("fare_amount").sum().alias("sum_fare_amount"))
        .sort("hour")
    )
```
